From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@pulseplus.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-30T09:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline and a couple MSA/order-form questions

Thanks Rafael / Emma — reviewed the redline and attached a focused markup (redwood-dpa-markup.docx) with suggested edits. Summary of our takeaways and proposed positions below.

1) Subprocessor notification / cadence
- Accept PulsePlus request for 30-day notice but propose the following exception: "In the event of critical infrastructure or security updates where prior notice is impossible, Redwood will notify Customer without undue delay after the change." This keeps operational flexibility for infra changes.

2) SCCs + Transfer Addendum
- We will sign the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021) and execute a short transfer addendum (we propose Annex 4). The addendum will:
  * Confirm controller/processor roles per DPA section 2;
  * Describe KMS responsibilities for customer-managed keys when selected;
  * Provide routing/hosting commitments for EU hosting SLOs.

3) Export Controls language in Order Form
- We can accept a short clause indicating hosting tiers and export controls apply; recommend a one-line schedule in the Order Form instead of modifying the MSA.

4) Evidence / SOC2 / Audit
- PulsePlus asked for a limited-scope SOC2 evidence pull for EU subprocessor list — we can produce a subprocessor roster export and an encrypted evidence package under a redaction agreement. Laura, please flag any additional compliance constraints.

Next steps: Laura to confirm legal redline positions and signoff path; Rafael to confirm whether we call a quick 30-minute legal handoff with PulsePlus. Emma — can you confirm availability for a legal sync on Monday (UK morning)?

Attachment: redwood-dpa-markup.docx (suggested edits)

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@pulseplus.health>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:14:00-04:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline and a couple MSA/order-form questions — legal position and DocuSign

Emma / Rafael / Ben — apologies for the slight delay. Legal has reviewed Ben's markup and PulsePlus's submissions. High-level stance: we can accept the majority of PulsePlus redlines with the edits Ben suggested. Specifics: 

- Subprocessor notice: agree to 30-day notice with the emergency carve. Proposed single-sentence amendment included in our markup.
- SCCs: Redwood will execute the EU SCCs (2021) and an annex transfer addendum. We will use a short-form annex limited to routing, KMS, and subprocessors (no broad new liability terms).
- Export Controls: agree to an Order Form schedule mentioning hosting tiers and export-controls responsibilities. Procurement note: this should be in the Order Form PDF (OrderForm_PulsePlus_v2.pdf) rather than in the master MSA.
- Evidence requests: we can provide the subprocessor roster snapshot plus an encrypted evidence bundle. If PulsePlus requires raw SOC2 artifacts, we will require a CDA and limited access window.

Docs & execution: I uploaded a consolidated tracked-change DPA and a draft Annex 4 (transfer addendum) and am happy to approve the package for signature once we reconcile one outstanding item: PulsePlus's request to add a 30-day termination right if Redwood materially changes subprocessor routing for EU-hosted data. We need either (a) tighten that to "material change affecting region" or (b) convert to an express remediation/fallback for 30 days before termination. Emma — can your legal team accept either (a) or (b)?

If yes, I'll issue the final DPA and bundle with the Order Form for DocuSign. DocuSign link (draft envelope) attached: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=ABC123-PULSEPLUS

Proposed timeline:
- Emma confirms (a) or (b) by EOD Tuesday (UK time)
- Final docs sent for signature Wed morning
- Target signature Fri (as Rafael requested)

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy, Redwood Inference
